dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Hehe, not the answer you were expecting to hear, hmm? Ah, the look of stunned surprise on your face... I think it might be my favorite.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Or to put it another way, seeing your reaction was exactly what I wanted to do.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Observing humans' reactions and reading about their lives are what interest me most in this world.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: In principle, I should remain an outside observer. But you are far too much fun for that. I can't help but tease you from time to time.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Oh, so it's my fault that you feel the need to tease me!?

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: If you liken human lives to light novels, every one has its highlights, but also inevitably has many aspects that are similar to all the others.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: As an observer, I get to see the similarities all the time, which naturally leaves me desiring to see something more unique.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Your story is one that has captivated me. I really do have high hopes for you... Please do your best to live up to them, child.

choices.text: My story? You mean my life story? Umm...

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: Don't you worry. You still have a long journey ahead of you... Your story has only just begun.

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: Besides, you will always have me as your trusty "editor," won't you?

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: Whenever you start going off on a misguided tangent, I'll correct you. And if you're ever stuck in a rut, I'll give you a little nudge towards the next chapter.

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: That should certainly help you on your journey, don't you agree?

choices.text: I'm not sure I can meet your expectations.
